verdicts.note: Management revised guidance from 4-4.5% down to 3.0-4.0% in May 2026, later maintained through Oct 2026.
verdicts.evidence_quote: For FY27, we are guiding an AUM growth of 20.0-25.0%, NIM of 12.8-13.2%, cost to income of 33.0-35.0%, credit cost of 3.0-4.0%, ROA of 4.0-4.8%, and an ROE of 16.0-20.0%.

verdicts.note: Target horizon is FY28; latest foreign borrowings stood at 24% as of Jul 2026 call.
FY27 is ongoing; management reaffirmed 20% to 25% AUM growth guidance in Oct 2026 call.
verdicts.evidence_quote: We retain our AUM growth guidance of 20% to 25%, supported by return to growth in Group Loan portfolio, coupled with continued momentum in Retail Finance.

verdicts.note: Management raised FY27 NIM guidance from 12.8-13.2% to 14.4-14.7% in Oct 2026.
verdicts.evidence_quote: We expect a NIM of 14.4% to 14.7% as against 12.8% to 13.2% guided earlier, driven by healthy asset quality, strong control over borrowing costs

verdicts.note: Management revised FY27 cost to income target to 29% to 30% from 33.0-35.0% in Oct 2026.
verdicts.evidence_quote: Cost to income may range between 29% to 30% as operating costs remain well under control, despite inflationary trends.

verdicts.note: Management raised FY27 ROA guidance from 4.0-4.8% to 5.2% to 5.8% in Oct 2026.
verdicts.evidence_quote: We raised our profitability guidance for FY27, ROA of 5.2% to 5.8% versus 4% to 4.8% earlier and ROE of 21% to 24% versus 16% to 20% earlier.

verdicts.note: Management raised FY27 ROE guidance from 16.0-20.0% to 21% to 24% in Oct 2026.
verdicts.evidence_quote: We raised our profitability guidance for FY27, ROA of 5.2% to 5.8% versus 4% to 4.8% earlier and ROE of 21% to 24% versus 16% to 20% earlier.

verdicts.note: Target horizon is CY2028; current reported period is Q2 FY27.
